# CH Analysis Meeting 2026-09-16

Decision meeting on the CH definition for the [[ch-cancer-risk-analysis]]. Present: [[lucas-brandt]], [[hannah-lindqvist]], Ines, [[maja-kovac]]; [[mei-lin-zhou]] sent comments in advance.

## Discussion

Lucas presented [[ch-vaf-threshold-comparison]]. He argued for 1%: the panel depth supports it, more carriers means more power, and the biology does not stop at 2%. Hannah pointed out that replicate concordance falls to 84% between 1% and 2%, and that in the MRD filter the same caller uses a lower threshold because there the cost of missing a CH variant is a false MRD call, which is a different trade-off ([[clonal-hematopoiesis]]). Maja argued for comparability with published cohort studies, almost all at 2%. Mei-Lin's written comment asked for one primary definition fixed before the 2025 follow-up is analysed.

## Decisions

- Primary definition VAF 2% or more; 1% or more as a prespecified secondary analysis.
- Gene-specific models for DNMT3A and TET2; a DNA damage response group as exploratory, after [[malighetti-2026-chip-ctdna-dual-compartments]].
- Fix this in [[ch-cancer-risk-analysis-plan]] v1.1 before opening the 2025 follow-up. Done the same day.

## Follow-up

Recorded as the answer in [[should-ch-be-defined-at-vaf-2-or-1-percent]].
